text:
- Define a set of vowels including both lowercase and uppercase: {'a','e','i','o','u','A','E','I','O','U'} to check membership in O(1).
- Iterate through the input string character by character, filtering out any characters that are in the vowel set; preserve all others (including newlines and consonants).
- Join the filtered characters into a new string and return it; handle empty input by naturally returning an empty string.
